item.title: Brooklyn’s Weeksville Finalizes Major Preservation Milestone
item.description: The restoration of the Hunterfly Road Houses at the Weeksville Heritage Center preserves four wood-frame homes built in the 19th century that stand as the last remaining structures of one of the nation’s largest free Black communities before the Civil War.

item.title: Man Charged With Attempted Murder in 36th Street Subway Shoving
item.description: van Negron, 39, who is homeless, allegedly pushed the 35-year-old just before 5:00am on Jan. 18 while he was standing on the southbound R train platform. The victim suffered a dislocated shoulder, according to court documents.

item.title: Federal Charges Added in Brooklyn Chabad Car Ramming Case
item.description: A Brooklyn man accused of ramming his car into the Chabad-Lubavitch World Headquarters now faces federal charges for damaging religious property.

item.title: Best of Brooklyn: Top 5 Lap Pools
item.description: Grab your goggles and jump in, Brooklyn!

item.title: Stay Up Late With The Brooklyn Public Library
item.description: Brooklyn Public Library celebrates the 10th annual "Night in the Library" on March 14, featuring a math-themed evening of talks, performances and interactive programs.

item.title: Supreme Court Blocks New York's Congressional District to be Redrawn
item.description: The conservative majority halted a state court ruling that had ordered New York’s redistricting commission to redraw New York's 11th congressional district that covers Staten Island and a small part of southern Brooklyn held by U.S. Representative Nicole Malliotakis.

item.title: Hearing Disabled NYCHA Residents to Get Services Under Settlement
item.description: Deaf or hard of hearing public housing tenants will receive auxiliary aids and services, interpreters and accessible devices under a new settlement NYCHA reached with the federal government over alleged accessibility violations.

item.title: Maimonides Merger With City Hospital System Set For April 1
item.description: Once the merger with New York City Health + Hospitals closes, the maternity ward will likely get a major overhaul.

item.title: Eastern Brooklyn to Get First 2-K Seats This Fall
item.description: Families who live in School Districts 18 and 23, which covers Canarsie, Remsen Village, Brownsville and Ocean Hill, can apply for a free, 2-K seat that will be available in the 2026-2027 school year.
